text: At the first waystation on the Vael road, the Director is already saddling a fresh horse.

speaker: Kai
text: You said four days. That was one.

speaker: Hesta
text: You still have three to go.

speaker: Kai
text: And you?

speaker: Hesta
text: There are matters at the Academy that cannot wait three days.

speaker: Kai
text: Does one of them involve me?

speaker: Hesta
text: Yes.

speaker: Kai
text: You could try being less reassuring.

speaker: Hesta
text: I am not trying to reassure you. I am trying to have the gates ready before you arrive.
She passes a sealed travel order to the road warden waiting beside the supply wagon.

speaker: Hesta
text: He travels with your party. The main road, the usual stops. No shortcuts.

speaker: Road Warden
text: Understood, Director.

speaker: Kai
text: You know what that sword is. I saw your face.

speaker: Hesta
text: You saw a woman in a hurry.

speaker: Kai
text: That is not an answer.

speaker: Hesta
text: You will find I rarely give one before it is useful.
Before he can ask again, the Director turns her horse toward the northern road.

speaker: Road Warden
text: Come along, then. People on foot arrive later than people with opinions and fresh horses.

speaker: Kai
text: I am beginning to suspect the Academy is full of both.
Days later, a day's travel from Vael, smoke rises beyond the roofs of a roadside hamlet.
